decisions.reason: A cutting and creasing finisher close to the core portfolio with its own product page fits the established Multigraf line and costs little to keep as a distributor offering.

The firm staged a public German premiere event for the UV spot varnishing system and presents it as a flagship of its move into embellishment, so visible commitment and strategic centrality make persistence very likely even if early sales are slow.
The sheet preparation module builds on the existing systems as a complementary component, so dropping it would gain little and weaken the modular offer.
The B2 multifinisher is shown on the home page as a flagship of the firm's direction and is close to its core Duplo partnership, so publicly announced commitment strongly favors keeping it.
The hybrid saddle stitcher sits squarely in the firm's booklet-making core and has its own product page, so it remains a natural part of the portfolio.
The folding add-on has a documented customer installation that combines it with the core creasing system, showing positive results that justify keeping it.
